caption: The drawing depicts a full-body statue of a woman standing on a rectangular pedestal. The woman is dressed in a layered outfit consisting of a lavender-pink tunic draped over her left shoulder with a sash, and a light blue skirt that ends above her knees. She wears a light grey-blue headdress and has beaded jewelry around her neck and wrists, as well as large round earrings. Her right arm is raised above her head with the hand open and slightly bent downward, while her left arm is extended outward with the palm up. The woman has brown skin, and her shoes are light yellow with a strap over the top. The drawing’s background is plain and light, with no additional objects or scenery, focusing the attention on the statue itself.
